status.description: Filter subscriptions by AutoPay status, such as pending_setup, trialing, active, past_due, canceled, expired, or setup_failed.

customer_id.description: Merchant-side customer identifier used when the subscription was created through Checkout.

created_after.description: Return subscriptions created on or after this date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

created_before.description: Return subscriptions created on or before this date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Number of subscriptions AutoPay should return. Defaults to 20; maximum is 100.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first subscription to return. Defaults to 0.
